highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM corrections and a WinUI .NET 9 fix.

bullets.detail: Library TFMs now use versioned Apple targets (e.g. ios26.0) and application TFMs use unversioned forms, matching Apple platform conventions and fixing downstream build warnings.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: The WinUI native projection DLL was not being located correctly for .NET 9 consumers. The asset resolution is now correct.
